name: week
title: Licensing desk: this week
subtitle: Internal target dates are local policy, not statutory clocks.

sections.title: Officer workload
sections.sql: select owner,count(*) as open_applications,count(*) filter(where days_left<0) as overdue_targets from application_readiness where status='open' group by owner order by owner

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from attention_queue order by due_on,record,issue

sections.title: Application checks
sections.sql: select code,applicant,owner,evidence_gaps,inspection_gaps,policy_gap,applicant_gap from application_readiness where status='open' order by code

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select application,requirement,finding from evidence_gaps where finding<>'Complete' order by application,requirement

sections.title: Next sixty days
sections.sql: select code,applicant,owner,expires_on,days_left,open_conditions from renewal_queue where days_left<=60 order by expires_on,code

sections.title: Conditions to review
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,review_on from conditions where status='open' order by review_on,code
